WITH active_life_cities AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.city) AS city_count
  FROM Business AS b
  JOIN Business_Categories AS bc ON bc.business_id = b.business_id
  JOIN Categories AS c ON c.category_id = bc.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name = 'Active Life'
), active_life_businesses AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_count
  FROM Business_Categories AS bc
  JOIN Categories AS c ON c.category_id = bc.category_id
  WHERE c.category_name = 'Active Life'
), low_review_businesses AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_count
  FROM Business
  WHERE review_count = 'Low'
)
SELECT city_count AS active_life_city_count,
       active_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(low_count, 0) AS percentage
FROM active_life_cities, active_life_businesses, low_review_businesses;

WITH city_flags AS (
  SELECT b.city,
         MAX(CASE WHEN c.category_name = 'Active Life' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_active_life,
         MAX(CASE WHEN b.review_count = 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_low_reviews
  FROM Business AS b
  LEFT JOIN Business_Categories AS bc ON bc.business_id = b.business_id
  LEFT JOIN Categories AS c ON c.category_id = bc.category_id
  GROUP BY b.city
)
SELECT SUM(has_active_life) AS active_life_city_count,
       SUM(has_active_life) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(has_low_reviews), 0) AS percentage
FROM city_flags;
